prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of Vercel's free Hobby plan (bandwidth, function invocations or duration, build minutes). Cite Vercel's documentation and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on Vercel's official documentation, here are the documented limits for the free Hobby plan regarding bandwidth, function invocations, function duration, and build minutes/times. 

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby | QUOTE: "Fast Data Transfer | First 100 GB" | CLAIM: The Hobby plan includes 100 GB of bandwidth (Fast Data Transfer) per month.
SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby | QUOTE: "Function Invocations | First 1,000,000" | CLAIM: The Hobby plan includes 1,000,000 serverless function invocations per month.
SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/limits | QUOTE: "Maximum duration | 300s (5 minutes) default and max" | CLAIM: The maximum duration for a Vercel Function execution on the Hobby plan is 300 seconds (5 minutes).
SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/limits | QUOTE: "The maximum duration of the Build Step is 45 minutes." | CLAIM: The maximum build time allowed per deployment on the Hobby plan is 45 minutes.
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: A total monthly limit for aggregate build minutes on the Hobby plan (as opposed to the per-deployment limit). Vercel documents a per-deployment build time limit of 45 minutes and a deployment creation limit of 100 per day, but does not appear to document a specific monthly cap on total build minutes for the Hobby plan.
